'''Min Gost''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] who worked as an [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]], operating from [[Kuzbar's Cantina]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. Following the [[Death/Legends|murder]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Popara Anjiliac Diresto]], a group of individuals that were investigating his death paid Gost to give them some information.
